commitments.detail: A custom dining table with natural oil finish, 60 inches long and 36 inches wide, delivered by October 15, 2023.
Iris will teach pottery classes to two people as part of the agreement.
Iris will provide four place settings as part of the agreement.
Two pottery lessons as part of the agreement
Four place settings included with the table
In exchange for pottery lessons and place settings, Iris will receive a custom dining table with rounded corners and a satin oil finish.
